//: Base manifest. scripts/build-vsix.js merges vscode-extension-addon/package.contributes.json into it.
name: dewa-sap-spec-builder
description: Functional and development specifications for SAP, inside VS Code – with read-only SAP system discovery through GitHub Copilot and the SAP MCP servers.

commands.title: Reinstall Spec Builder agents (dewa-fs-discovery, dewa-abap-change, dewa-fiori, dewa-fiori-review)
Check Fiori MCP servers (SAP Fiori + UI5 for dewa-fiori)

dewaSpecBuilder.installAgent.description: Install the Spec Builder agents (dewa-fs-discovery, dewa-abap-change, dewa-fiori, dewa-fiori-review) into the VS Code prompts folder on start-up (an edited copy is never replaced).

dewaSpecBuilder.fioriMcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Provide the **SAP Fiori MCP server** (`fiori-mcp`) and the **UI5 MCP server** (`ui5-mcp`) for the `dewa-fiori` agent. VS Code 1.101+ gets them automatically (it asks once to trust / start them); older versions get an *Add to my mcp.json* button. A server you define yourself in an `mcp.json` under the same name is left to you. Needs Node.js 20.17+.

dewaSpecBuilder.fioriMcp.fioriServerVers.markdownDescription: Pinned version of `@sap-ux/fiori-mcp-server`. Change it only after testing a newer version.

dewaSpecBuilder.fioriMcp.ui5ServerVersio.markdownDescription: Pinned version of `@ui5/mcp-server`. Change it only after testing a newer version.

dewaSpecBuilder.fioriMcp.allowedDomains.markdownDescription: Hosts the UI5 MCP server may contact (`UI5_MCP_SERVER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS`), comma-separated – add your SAP front-end server, e.g. `localhost, s4dev.example.internal`.

dewaSpecBuilder.fioriMcp.caCertFile.markdownDescription: Path to DEWA's root CA certificate (PEM) for the SAP host, passed as `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` – e.g. `C:\\certs\\dewa-root-ca.pem`. Leave empty if not needed.

mcpServerDefinitionProviders.label: DEWA – SAP Fiori and UI5 MCP servers
